arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent 2D Cartoon sprite, SHARK035. Image1 controls exact original pose, facing, body visibility, pupils and expression. Image2 is STYLE ONLY: gray upper skin, cream/pale underside, crisp black outlines and simple cel shading. One complete AIRBORNE shark arched across the image. Snout points DOWN-LEFT, eye visible on near side, gray rounded back above and pale underside below, pectoral fins hang beneath, tail curves to LOWER-RIGHT. Keep exact whole-body inverted-U curve and left/down orientation. Source has NO attached water: do not add a splash or shadow. Match original geometry before style. Attached source water must be white/pale-blue foam and light-blue water only, with transparent gaps and NO dark shadow/puddle. No scenery, floor, horizon, extra animals, glow or text. Preserve whole source silhouette with ample transparent margin. Genuine alpha background. Mouth pink/red, teeth white.
